title: Prove exact first-reader stock limits for BIT receipt replacement
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Among 2,049 noncentral simultaneously unread receiver cohorts in the original word, no cheaper replacement uses at most the original receipt count and preserves the old local demand at the first reader. The 2,040 full-rank cohorts have the original optimal sorted grades. Nine adjoint rank-two demands of size three cannot be supplied by two attainable receipts. A distinct one-omission test excludes all 97,657 cheaper, different-donor direct pairs before the original payload’s first read.

## Task and overlap

This is a refined follow-up to [#7852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7852) at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Pinned native and nearest fixed-stock, geometry and terminal scopes [#7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, [#7953](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7953) at `13a47f662901e894fee93365c7efec89f4f21fae`, [#7983](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7983) at `5f393bfc838276228ff8adfee9c5625d8ce9197f`, [#7985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7985) at `251e15df3e0c058a843e7cb13f5882179a4e3afc`. The packet relaxation grants free old history. It freezes the other paid equations and first-reader demands.

## Validation

In a clean Python 3.12 extraction run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -I -B verify.py`. All four directional receipts regenerate byte for byte. The census records grades, demand coordinates and actual histories for optimal unchanged controls.

## Open next questions

Explore actual changed paid equations, first-reader clocks or terminal demands. Additional paid receipts beyond the separate direct-pair scope need a new check.
